title: Lifting one finite separable residue extension
statement: Let R be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] with residue field kappa, and let L be a finite separable field extension of kappa [def-pc-field-extension], [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. There exists a finite etale R-algebra S [def-weil-etale-morphism] and a kappa-algebra isomorphism $\kappa\otimes_R S\cong L$.

proof.text: Choose a primitive element alpha of L/kappa using [lem-weil-pbc-finite-separable-extension-primitive-element]. Its minimal polynomial g is monic and separable. The residue homomorphism R -> kappa is surjective; Polynomial.lifts_and_natDegree_eq_and_monic lifts g to a monic f in R[X]. Put A = R[X]/(f). By [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free], A is module-finite over R. This construction is the monic-polynomial construction of Stacks 00UD, specialized to the maximal ideal of a local ring.

Prove directly that the class of f derivative is a unit in A. Otherwise its principal ideal is contained in a maximal ideal q. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-algebra-local-radical], q contracts to the maximal ideal m of R, so R -> A/q descends to a homomorphism phi: kappa -> A/q. The image x of X is a root of g, since f vanishes in A. Separability of g implies g derivative evaluated at x is nonzero (Polynomial.Separable.eval2_derivative_ne_zero). But this value is the image of the class of f derivative, which belongs to q, a contradiction. The Lean proof explicitly checks the evaluation identity for every polynomial and commutation of derivative with coefficient mapping.

Take the standard etale pair (f, f derivative). Since the derivative is already a unit in A, evaluation at the class of X gives its standard etale algebra an R-algebra isomorphism to A; the inverse sends the class of X to the standard generator. AdjoinRoot.algHom_ext and StandardEtalePair.hom_ext verify the two composites. Hence A is etale, using the Mathlib standard-etale instance and Algebra.Etale.of_equiv. This is proved as local glue in the main Lean proof; there is no additional unproved assertion.

AdjoinRoot.tensorAlgEquiv, followed by AdjoinRoot.mapAlgEquiv for the tensor right-identity equivalence, gives kappa tensor_R A isomorphic to kappa[X]/(g). By [lem-weil-pbc-minimal-polynomial-quotient-field-iso] this is kappa(alpha), and the primitive-element equality identifies it with L. Use ULift of A to put the constructed finite etale algebra in universe max(u,v), transporting its finite and etale instances along ULift.algEquiv and applying Algebra.TensorProduct.congr to the fibre. Compose all kappa-algebra equivalences. The degree-one case is handled by the same construction; no nontriviality or characteristic case is excluded.
